# `--web` launcher and the hidden `--web-serve` run process ## What to build Wire the previous pieces into the CLI. `graph-execution --spec --provider

--web` (and `graph-execution --resume [--run ] --web`) runs preflight with no side effects, writes the wrapper script, hands the run to the OS as a detached background process, waits up to 15 s for that process to serve its page, opens the page in the browser (or prints the URL and an `ssh -L` hint over SSH), prints one line and exits 0. The OS-started process is the same CLI with `--web` replaced by the internal `--web-serve`: it does the normal startup, starts the web view instead of the Ink UI, writes `web.json` and the ready file, keeps serving the final state after the run ends until **Close**, then exits with the run's exit code. Exit codes of the launcher: 0 started, 2 preflight error or the run did not start, **3** hand-off blocked (prints the exact foreground command). ## Context: files to read before implementing - `src/cli.ts` (all, esp. 81–112, 114–174) — option parsing, `runGraph`, the `--resume` branch, `setExitCode`, `main()`; this is where `--web`/`--web-serve` are added. - `src/launch/preflight.ts`, `src/launch/script.ts`, `src/launch/handoff.ts`, `src/launch/quote.ts` — pieces from earlier tasks: `preflight()`, `assertNotRunning()`, `writeLaunchScript()`, `planHandoff()`/`handoff()`/`waitForReady()`, `quoteFor()`. - `src/web/start.ts`, `src/web/server.ts` — `startWebUi(opts)` returning `WebUiHandle` with `url`, `closed`, `close()`. - `src/runner/run.ts` (lines 58–74, 225–253) — `RunGraphOptions.ui` is called synchronously in `execute()`; `startWebUi` is async, so change the type to `(opts: UiOptions) => UiHandle | Promise` and `await` it. Also pass `runDir: ctx.runDir` in the `UiOptions` object (add `runDir?: string` to `UiOptions` in `src/ui/start.tsx`). - `src/readme/readme.ts` (lines 13–35) — `openCommand` and the private `openInBrowser`; export `openInBrowser` and reuse it (it works for URLs too: `open`, `cmd /c start "" `, `xdg-open`). - `src/state/errors.ts` — `ExitCode` union (0|1|2); add `EXIT_HANDOFF_BLOCKED = 3` and widen `ExitCode`. - `src/state/resume.ts` (lines 22–33) — `findRun`, `runDirOf`; `web.json` lives in `.graph-execution//`. - `src/cli.test.ts` (lines 18–78) — how CLI behaviors are tested against `dist/cli.js` in a temp repo with the fake provider (`GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT`, `src/__fixtures__/diamond`, `spec.md`). ## Patterns to follow **One place sets the exit code:** `setExitCode(code)` in `cli.ts`; thrown errors are printed as `error: ` by `main()` and exit 2. Exit 3 is set explicitly. **Injectable dependencies for tests:** `showReadme({ open, out })` in `src/readme/readme.ts:21–29`. Do the same for the launcher: `launchWeb(opts, deps?: { handoff, waitForReady, open, out, env, platform })` in `src/launch/launch.ts`, so the browser and ready-file behavior are unit-tested without spawning anything. **Internal env hooks (documented only in code comments):** `GRAPH_EXECUTION_KILL_AT` in `src/state/state.ts:66`. Add `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF` (`detached` = skip the OS services and use only the detached spawn; `none` = every choice fails) so CLI end-to-end tests never touch `launchctl`/`systemd-run`/`schtasks`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `src/launch/launch.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `launchWeb({ argv, cwd, env, platform })`: 1. `preflight()` for the same args the run will get (for `--resume` also `assertNotRunning(runDir)`). Errors propagate as today (exit 2). Nothing is created. 2. `writeLaunchScript` with `args` = the user's arguments minus `--web`, `execPath: process.execPath`, `cliPath: fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` of `dist/cli.js` (resolve via `new URL("../cli.js", import.meta.url)` from `dist/launch/`). 3. `planHandoff` + `handoff`. If not ok: print `Could not start the run in the background (). Run this in a terminal:` followed by `cd ` and the foreground command (the original args without `--web`, each quoted with `quoteFor(platform, …)`), return exit code **3**. 4. `waitForReady`. If not ok: print `error: the run did not start` and the log tail (stderr), exit **2**. 5. Print `Started run in the background: ` and open the browser with `openInBrowser(url)`. Over SSH (`SSH_CONNECTION` or `SSH_TTY` set) don't open; print `Run started: ` and `From your machine: ssh -L :127.0.0.1: , then open http://127.0.0.1:/`. If opening fails, ignore the failure and print the `Run started: ` form. Exit 0. - **GOTCHA**: the launcher never creates a run id or directory; the run process does. `--web` always detaches, even when a human types it. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -- launch` ### EDIT `src/cli.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: add `.option("--web", "start the run in the background and open its live view in the browser")` and a hidden `new Option("--web-serve").hideHelp()`. Reject `--web` together with `--web-serve`. If `--web`: call `launchWeb` and `setExitCode` with its result; do not run anything else. If `--web-serve`: require `process.env.GRAPH_EXECUTION_READY_FILE`, else throw `UsageError("--web-serve is internal")`; run the normal path (`runGraph`/`resume`) with `ui: webServeUi(...)` (below) instead of `startUi`, then `await handle.closed`, remove `web.json`, and set the exit code to the run's. `install`, `readme` and `open` are subcommands, so `--web` before them is an unknown option for them (exit 2); add a test. - **IMPLEMENT**: widen `ExitCode` with 3 (`EXIT_HANDOFF_BLOCKED`) in `src/state/errors.ts`; `exitCodeFor` is unchanged. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -- cli` ### CREATE `src/web/serve.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `webServeUi(env)` returns `{ ui: (opts: UiOptions) => Promise, handle(): WebUiHandle | undefined }`. The `ui` function calls `startWebUi`, then (1) writes `/web.json` = `{ url, pid }`, (2) writes the ready file named by `GRAPH_EXECUTION_READY_FILE` = `{ url, runId, pid }` (write to `.tmp` then rename), (3) deletes the wrapper script's directory (`dirname(readyFile)` only if its basename starts with `graph-execution-launch-`; do this after the ready file is written) and, on Windows, the scheduled task `GRAPH_EXECUTION_TASK_NAME` with `schtasks /delete /tn /f` (ignore failures), (4) wraps `log` so every line (agent output lines too) is also appended to `/run.log` with a time prefix. A fatal error thrown by the run after the server is up: the CLI catches it, appends it to `run.log`, calls `handle.setFatal({ message, hint })` (add this to `WebUiHandle` and the server: the snapshot gets `fatal`, `/close` and the page's **Close** are allowed when `summary || fatal`, `/abort` answers 409), and still waits for Close. - **GOTCHA**: `runDir` is needed by the UI: it comes from the `runDir` field added to `UiOptions`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck` ### EDIT `src/runner/run.ts`, `src/ui/start.tsx`, `src/readme/readme.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: as listed in the context section (`await` the UI factory, `runDir` in `UiOptions`, export `openInBrowser`). - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -- run ui readme` ### CREATE tests - **IMPLEMENT** (`src/launch/launch.test.ts`, injected deps): preflight failure → exit 2 and no hand-off call and no `.graph-execution/` in the repo; hand-off blocked → exit 3, output contains `cd ` and the exact foreground command; ready file never written → exit 2 with the log tail; ready → opener called once with the URL and the line `Started run in the background: `; SSH env → opener not called, `ssh -L` hint printed, exit 0; a live lock on `--resume` → exit 2 with `already running (PID n)`. - **IMPLEMENT** (`src/web-e2e.test.ts` or in `src/cli.test.ts`, against `dist/cli.js` with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached` and `SSH_CONNECTION` set so no browser opens): run the diamond fixture with the fake provider and `--web`; assert exit 0 within 15 s, the printed URL, `GET /state` eventually has `summary.exitCode === 0` (poll), `POST /close` with a matching `Origin` → 200, `web.json` disappears and the process is gone (check the pid from `web.json`). Also `--web` with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=none` → exit 3 with the foreground command. Always kill the pid in `finally`. - **PATTERN**: `src/cli.test.ts:18–50`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -- launch web-e2e cli` ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `--web` (new run and `--resume`) hands the run off, opens or prints the page, and exits 0 within a few seconds; the run behaves like a run started by hand. - [ ] Any failure a normal run has before starting agents makes `--web` exit 2 without calling the hand-off and without creating `.graph-execution/`. - [ ] A run process that dies or never gets ready makes the launcher exit 2 with `error: the run did not start` and the last 20 lines of `launch.log`. - [ ] A blocked hand-off exits 3 and prints `Could not start the run in the background (). Run this in a terminal:`, `cd ` and the foreground command. - [ ] Over SSH the URL and the `ssh -L` hint are printed and the exit code is 0. - [ ] `web.json` (`{ url, pid }`) exists while the run process lives and is removed after Close; the wrapper script directory is deleted once the run is ready. - [ ] After the run ends the server keeps serving the final state until Close; the process then exits with the run's exit code. - [ ] `--web` is refused by `install` and `readme`. - [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -- launch cli web-e2e` ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -- launch cli web-e2e ```
